Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for the attachments. A couple quick notes and requests so we can complete supplier setup and issue POs correctly: 

1) For B2B software/support services where Redwood is the customer and you have a valid EU VAT ID, we typically apply the reverse-charge treatment and issue the PO net of VAT. We need an official EU VAT certificate copy and the VAT number that will appear on invoices (you included BE1234567890 — please confirm which legal entity that maps to).

2) For physical goods: import VAT handling depends on Incoterms for each shipment and whether Redwood is the importer of record. If Beeline will handle import and charge Redwood VAT on the invoice, we need your invoice to show VAT separately. If Redwood imports directly, we can net the PO and Redwood will self-account for import VAT. Please clarify your normal workflow.

3) Attachments needed to finish onboarding:
   - EU VAT certificate (certified copy)
   - Company registration (Chamber of Commerce extract)
   - Supplier onboarding form (attached below)
   - Bank details and beneficiary name matching the company registration

Action: Can you send the statutory company extract and confirm the VAT entity name that matches BE1234567890? Once we have those, procurement will create the PO with the appropriate VAT note (reverse charge or VAT included).

Thanks — Karthik

Thanks — reviewed the VAT cert. Procurement/Finance notes below for PO creation: 

- If vendor confirms BE1234567890 for B2B service invoices to Redwood BE or other EU entities, issue PO net of VAT with a note: "Reverse charge applies under Article 194, VAT Directive; supplier to quote valid EU VAT registration."
- PO default tax code: EU-SVC-REV (this routes to tax validation flow).
- For goods where vendor charges Belgian VAT (DDP shipments), PO should include VAT line and total gross value; Finance will remit per invoice.

Checklist before PO issuance: 
1) Supplier onboarding form completed & signed (we need the PDF back).
2) VAT cert copy and company extract on file.
3) Bank account beneficiary matches registration (we will flag mismatch).
